title: Tree Height Monitor
description: Given a binary tree in level-order representation where -1 represents a missing child, determine its height measured as the number of nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; node values are integers; the root is never missing.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n values in level-order representation, where -1 represents a missing node.
outputFormat: Print the height of the tree.
hints: The height of a node is one plus the larger height of its two children.

examples.explanation: The longest root-to-leaf path contains three nodes.
